description: Create a Table of Authorities for the appellate brief at /home/ga/Documents/appellate_brief_draft.docx. You must: (1) Find and mark all instances of the cases 'Hadley v. Baxendale' and 'Hawkins v. McGee' as 'Cases' (Category 1); (2) Find and mark the statutes 'U.C.C. § 2-715' and '28 U.S.C. § 1332' as 'Statutes' (Category 2); (3) Insert the Table of Authorities on the blank Page 2 under the 'Table of Authorities' heading. Ensure the table includes both categories. Save the result as /home/ga/Documents/appellate_brief_final.docx.
